name: agentdx
description: Assess repository agentic engineering readiness. Scores agent configs, setup, CI/CD, proof loops, adaptability, security, and workflow.

interface.longDescription: Assess how well your repository is set up for agentic engineering workflows. Scans agent config files, instruction quality, security & git hygiene, repo structure, setup and environment, CI/CD integration, development workflow, proof and feedback loops, and adaptability. Reports a score, readiness level, proof level, confidence, actionable findings, and recommendations.
defaultPrompt: Run an agentdx scan on this repo
